rules.reason: High humidity (>80%) with cool-moderate temperatures (15-25°C) and recent rainfall create ideal conditions for Phytophthora infestans
rules.action: Apply preventive fungicide (Metalaxyl + Mancozeb). Avoid overhead irrigation. Ensure good air circulation between plants.

rules.reason: Warm temperatures (24-35°C) with moderate humidity (>70%) favor Alternaria solani growth
rules.action: Monitor plants closely. Apply Mancozeb or Azoxystrobin at first sign of concentric ring spots on lower leaves.

rules.reason: Moderate humidity (>60%) with warm temperatures (20-30°C) and dry conditions encourage powdery mildew fungi
rules.action: Apply Sulphur 80% WDG preventively. Ensure good spacing between plants. Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilization.

rules.reason: Very high humidity (>85%) with cool temperatures (18-25°C) and significant rainfall create optimal conditions for downy mildew
rules.action: Spray copper-based fungicide immediately. Remove lower infected leaves. Improve drainage around root zone.

rules.reason: Warm humid conditions (>75% humidity, 22-32°C) with light rainfall promote Cercospora and other leaf spot pathogens
rules.action: Apply Mancozeb foliar spray at 10-day intervals. Remove and destroy infected leaves. Avoid overhead watering.

rules.reason: High humidity (>85%) and moderate temperatures (20-30°C) with wetness are highly favorable for Magnaporthe oryzae
rules.action: Apply Tricyclazole 75% WP immediately. Reduce nitrogen dose. Maintain shallow standing water in fields.

rules.reason: Cool-moderate temperatures (15-25°C) with moderate humidity (>70%) and dew formation favor rust spore germination
rules.action: Scout fields regularly. Apply Propiconazole or Tebuconazole at flag leaf stage. Use resistant varieties if available.

rules.reason: Warm wet conditions (>80% humidity, 25-35°C) with heavy rainfall create splashing that spreads Colletotrichum spores
rules.action: Spray Carbendazim + Mancozeb. Harvest ripe fruits promptly. Ensure proper drainage and spacing.
